name: Kindling Spirits
source:
Aster has been bringing Cordie on wilderness canoe camping trips all summer. Magic is afoot in the woods during their nightly campfire, but talk keeps returning to real life looming on the horizon.

[From [url=https://alliemackie.itch.io/kindling-spirits]Itch.io][/url]
translation:
整个夏天，阿斯特一直带着科迪去野外划独木舟、露营。每当夜晚围坐篝火时，林间似乎有魔法悄然涌动，可两人的话题总会回到即将到来的现实生活。

[摘自[url=https://alliemackie.itch.io/kindling-spirits]itch.io[/url]]
